title: [review] messaging.py:137: _next_id can exceed u64 range
description: When a client provides id=_MESSAGE_ID_MAX (2^64-1), line 137 computes candidate_next_id = body['id'] + 1 = 2^64, which exceeds the u64 range defined by _MESSAGE_ID_MAX. This value is stored in _next_id on line 150. While subsequent auto-ID requests fail gracefully via the SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE guard on line 132-133, the internal state holds an out-of-range value. If _next_id is ever serialized or the code evolves, this could cause truncation or errors. Consider clamping: `candidate_next_id = min(body['id'] + 1, _MESSAGE_ID_MAX + 1)` or explicitly checking bounds before assignment.
